about: Sentinel and poison probes in the set tree: a rule, policy or nested set under a target that is true, false, ends or fails; a sentinel rule beside a sibling rule, policy, nested set or top-level set whose outcome cannot stop the stand from reading it (not terminal, not failed); the passes of an iterate node over two grants; two bulk items; a PIP another PIP's requestAttributes names; a filter predicate's placeholder. Every request records the calls of /api/v1/pip/s44-sent.
